title: Young musicians, rock and roll and Preservation Hall audiences
summary: Punch discusses why young people like Dixieland, mentions Japan and London, rock and roll, and young clarinetist Tommy Sancton.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
